issue_title: Database connection timeout under concurrent load
body: Hey @bob-silva, I encountered this during migration. You need to increase pool_size=10 and max_overflow=20 in session.py. Check my PR #2.

issue_title: Docker compose network failure on macOS
body: Use host.docker.internal in the local development env instead of localhost. Added notes to README in commit a1b2c3d001.

issue_title: API response schema validation errors in tests
body: Make sure you include the Bearer token in the Authorization header. I added an auth test utility in test_security.py.
Thanks Alice. We will align the React forms to match the Pydantic schemas in your spec.
